evidence.detail: 1928 no. 6, p. 659: separately identifies Csanád, Arad and Torontál as provisionally united administrative counties of Hungary; the June 1928 window is only the issue's documentary observation.
1923:XXXV §§11–12, published 27 September 1923, legal basis for provisional joint administration; enactment alone does not verify precise operational commencement.

nodes.provenance: Documentary institution for the interwar Hungarian territorial organization. Distinct ID from pre-1918 OHM documentary parent; no continuity of legal or geometric identity inferred.
